source_workbook: MI Performance Appraisal Development Form YE2025.xlsx
instructions:
1.Using Section I below (Reviewee / Employee Section), the employee completes his/her self-assessment against his /her job responsibilities/tasks/goals/objectives referring to the  job description 1(a).Using the below rating scale, the manager completes the section (Reviewer/Manager's Section I) based on the performance of the employee's responsibilities, goals/objectives. Only whole numbers (1-5) are allowed. The manager should provide specific details relative to the performance of the goal/objective. The manager enters the Number of Goals in the appropriate section. Section I is weighted 70% of the total rating. Space for up to 5 goals is provided; if all spaces are not needed please leave them blank.
2. Using Section II employee completes his / her additional contributions to the organisation. Using the below rating scale, the Reviewer / Manager completes section II based on the Reviewee's / Employee's input. Only whole numbers are allowed. The manager should provide specific details relative to the performance of the competency. Section II is weighted 10% of the total rating.
3. Using Section III employee completes his / her additional contributions to the organisation. Using the below rating scale, the Reviewer / Manager completes section II based on the Reviewee's / Employee's input. Only whole numbers are allowed. The manager should provide specific details relative to the performance of the competency. Section II is weighted 20% of the total rating.
4. The Reviewer / Manager provides their overall comments in the Manager's Comments using Section IV. 
5. The Reviewer/Manager and the employee meet in person and review the performance appraisal. The employee may add comments in the Employee's Comments section.
6. The Reviewer/Manager completes the future job responsibilities, tasks, and objectives for the forthcoming year 
7. Both parties sign the appraisal and forward the original copy to Human Resources office
goal_description_label: List different areas of your responsibilities/performance parameters ( as per your job description or role requirements)
goal_narrative_label:
Self Evaluation of Task / Goal /Objective Achievement 
Provide a summary of your achievements / contributions against these areas of resposbility/targets.  Hightlight your most significant contributions to our business in this annual review period / what did you accomplish during this period
contribution_instruction: To be completed by Reviewee/Employee (Employee to write the area of contribution and explain their contributions)
business_achievements_label: 1. What do you consider to be your most important achievements/contributions to the success of the company / project during the year?
development_achievements_label: 2. What do you think are you important achievements for your personal/professional development during the year ?
development_instruction:
PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT GOALS FOR 2026 (BASED ON YOUR DISCUSSION WITH THE LINE MANAGER OR CLIENT MANAGER

1. What growth and/or development would you like to achieve in the next six months?


2. List the technical and personal development needs/plans that you need to achieve in 2026 and the support required to meet your development needs.
rating_scale: Performance: significantly and consistently exceeds goals
Competency: consistently demonstrates exceptional behaviors; serves as a role model and mentor
Performance: consistently achieves and often exceeds goals
Competency: consistently demonstrates effective behaviors and often demonstrates exceptional behaviors
Performance: achieves some, but not all goals; needs improvement
Competency: demonstrates some behaviors but not others, or uses behaviors inconsistently; may be appropriate for
employees in new or more challenging positions, or for those who need development
Performance: rarely achieves established goals; requires significant and immediate improvement
Competency: rarely demonstrates competency behaviors; requires significant development
